競合(相手の資料に記載)

companies.name: グローバル・ペイメンツ

relations.text: Global Paymentsからイシュアー事業を買収し、Worldpayの残り持分を売却(2026年1月完了)
relations.text_en: Bought its Issuer Solutions business and sold it the remaining Worldpay stake (closed January 2026)

source.label: FIS 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On January 9, 2026, FIS completed its previously announced (i) acquisition of the Issuer Solutions business ("the "Issuer Solutions Business") from Global Payments Inc.

relations.text: Global Paymentsが10-Kで、競合の一社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Global Payments names FIS among competitors

source.label: Global Payments 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our competitors in this business include, but are not limited to, Fiserv, FIS, Marqeta, Nexi, Worldline, i2c, Bill.com

relations.text: 加盟店決済事業の55%をGTCRに売却し(2024年1月)、合弁の45%を保有
relations.text_en: Sold 55% of its merchant business to GTCR in January 2024, keeping 45% of the venture

source.label: FIS 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: FIS retained a non-controlling 45% equity interest in a new standalone joint venture, Worldpay Holdco, LLC ("Worldpay"), following the closing of the 2024 Worldpay Sale.

relations.text: FISの本人確認(KYC)製品に技術を提供し、FISから出資を受ける
relations.text_en: Supplies its platform to FIS's KYC product and received an FIS investment

source.label: T Stamp 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In 2022, the Company expanded its key customer base to include an investment from and a relationship with FIS, a relationship-focused upon the implementation of our Orchestration Layer in FIS' Global KYC product offering.

relations.text: FISのシステム障害で2025年1月にサービスが数日止まった
relations.text_en: A multi-day outage at FIS hit its services in January 2025

source.label: Capital One 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For example, in January 2025, we experienced a multi-day system outage due to a technical issue experienced by FIS, a third-party service provider

companies.name: アメラント・バンコープ

relations.text: バックオフィス業務をFISに複数年で委託
relations.text_en: Outsources back-office functions to FIS under a multi-year agreement

source.label: Amerant Bancorp 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: the Company entered into a new multi-year outsourcing agreement with financial technology leader FIS to assume full responsibility over a significant number of the Bank's support functions and staff

companies.name: マイアミ・インターナショナル

relations.text: 子会社Dorman Tradingが清算・経理をFISに委託(2029年まで)
relations.text_en: Its Dorman Trading unit uses FIS for back-office clearing through 2029

source.label: Miami International Holdings 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Dorman Trading has a services agreement with FIS Capital Markets US LLC (as amended, the "FIS Agreement") for certain back-office clearing and accounting services.

relations.text: Q2が10-Kで、勘定系の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Q2 names FIS among core processing competitors

source.label: Q2 Holdings 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: We also compete with core processing vendors that provide systems and services such as Fiserv, Jack Henry and Associates and Fidelity National Information Services, or FIS.

relations.text: ACIが10-Kで、請求書払いの主な競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: ACI lists FIS first among bill payment competitors

source.label: ACI Worldwide 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Bill Payment The principal competitors for our ACI Speedpay bill payments solution are FIS, Fiserv, Invoice Cloud

relations.text: SS&Cが10-Kで、銀行向けの大手競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: SS&C names FIS among large banking competitors

source.label: SS&C 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: larger providers of enterprise systems, such as FIS and Misys.

companies.name: クリアウォーター・アナリティクス

relations.text: Clearwaterが10-Kで、主な競合の一社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Clearwater names FIS among its principal competitors

source.label: Clearwater Analytics 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: BlackRock's Aladdin, FIS's iWorks and Northern Trust.

relations.text: CPIが10-Kで、カード関連の競合の一社として挙げる
relations.text_en: CPI Card Group names FIS among competitors

source.label: CPI Card Group 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: CompoSecure L.L.C., Entrust, FIS, Fiserv, Giesecke & Devrient GmbH

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
